description: UAE -> Sweden. SLOT-CHECK ONLY: reach Step 1 (Appointment Details), then for each centre/category combination read the 'Earliest available slot' banner and report all results via Telegram. No booking is made.

slot_check._comment_labels: Labels must be UNIQUE within a route — a waitlist client file names the combination it wants by label, and duplicates would silently resolve to whichever came first. Here the centre AND category are identical across each pair; only sub_category ('Business' vs 'ShortStay') distinguishes them, so the label has to carry that. The centre/category/sub_category values themselves are UNTOUCHED — they must stay the portal's exact dropdown text.
